title: Buddy rotation + interview drift notes (week of Aug 18-22, 2025)
content:
Meeting: Weekly hiring + onboarding sync (platform engineering)
Date: 2025-08-21
Facilitator / owner: Maya Chen
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Tomás Rivera, Ethan Brooks, Priya Singh, Jonah Lee, Maya Chen (notes)
Purpose: Quick sync on interview feedback trends ("drift"), buddy rotations for recent new hires, and signals about team health and capacity. Capture actions that are lightweight and time-bound.

Agenda recap
- 10m: Interview debriefs and drift signals
- 10m: Onboarding / buddy rotation updates (2 new grads + 1 mid-level SWE started last week)
- 10m: Team health signals and capacity planning for next sprint
- 5m: Action items and owners

Notes - Interview debriefs and drift
1) Summary of candidate feedback (this week: 8 onsite-ish debriefs across infra & runtime roles)
   - Positive pattern: candidates who had pair-prog exercises with a runtime engineer consistently mention good problem framing and clear feedback loops. (Callout: Tomás and Ethan's sessions got explicit praise.)
   - Drift detected: Slight mismatch between advertised expectations in job descriptions vs. interview live exercise. Several candidates expected more data/ML-focused problems; interviews leaned toward infra design and performance trade-offs.
   - Impact: A couple of strong candidates (mid-sr infra) hesitated because they expected more ML/inference-context content. Recruiting reports a 12% drop in acceptance propensity for infra-oriented roles in the last 6 weeks.

2) Concrete examples from debriefs
   - Candidate A (applied infra): enjoyed systems design question but said "lack of explicit connection to our model-serving product" made it hard to judge fit.
   - Candidate B (applied runtime): struggled with an open-ended async batching question because the exercise timeline felt ambiguous; interviewer noted the prompt could be tightened.
   - Candidate C (SRE candidate): gave great answers on incident triage but confused by a follow-up on cost-modeling that wasn't in the JD.

3) Quick proposals to reduce drift
   - Short-term (this week): Add a one-line "what to expect" note to the interviewer packet and invite email to candidates (owner: Aisha; due: 2025-08-24).
   - Medium-term: Align job descriptions with standard interview templates. Create two variants of the infra interview: "inference-infra" and "core-infra" so candidates know the emphasis (owner: Priya + recruiting; due: 2025-09-05).
   - Interviewer training: Run a 30m calibration session for hiring panel to sync prompts and rubric (owner: Tomás; suggested date: 2025-08-28).

Notes - Onboarding and buddy rotation
1) New joiner snapshot (started Aug 14–18)
   - Riley (New Grad, runtime): Completed orientation, first-week checklist mostly green. Buddy: Jonah (rotation week 1 & 2). Observed friction: difficulty locating a working local test model on laptop due to missing Docker credential; workaround doc exists but not linked in welcome checklist.
   - Noor (New Grad, infra): Buddy: Aisha. Completed pairing sessions on autoscaler basics. Wants more structured reading list on quantization/compilation since she expects to touch those systems.
   - Marcos (Mid-level SWE, platform infra): Buddy: Ethan. Ramp is going slower due to on-call overlap; recommend reducing greenfield tasks in sprint 26.

2) Buddy rotation notes
   - Rotation plan: Week 1–2: focused pairing + environment setup. Week 3–4: shadowing real tasks (bug triage, small PRs). Week 5: independent owner of a small spike.
   - Pain point: Current buddy assignments not reflected in calendar invites (several new hires reported buddies not booked). Action: auto-create first-3-weeks recurring calendar invite when offer accepted (owner: Jonah; due: 2025-08-29).
   - Doc gaps: "Getting a local test model" doc needs a one-click section in the new-hire checklist with credential step-by-step. (owner: Maya; due: 2025-08-26).

3) Quick wins we can ship this sprint
   - Add a "first-run checklist" card to the onboarding Confluence page with the Docker credential flow and a verified link to the small demo model (owner: Maya; linked_artifact: CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-612).
   - Create a 20m recorded walkthrough for new grads showing how to run the tiny-model inference end-to-end (owner: Ethan; due: 2025-08-30).

Notes - Team health and capacity
1) Signals flagged in 1:1s this week
   - A few folks reported stretched bandwidth due to overlapping hiring interviews + sprint deliverables (particularly on runtime infra and SRE).
   - Burnout indicator: one team member explicitly said "I had 2 interviews plus two on-call incidents this week" — that's unsustainable.

2) Immediate mitigation suggestions
   - Protect capacity: block 8 hours per engineer for deep work during interview-heavy weeks; update interview rota to avoid scheduling full-day interview blocks back-to-back (owner: Priya; coordinate with recruiting; due: 2025-08-25).
   - Hire funnel: expedite top-of-funnel screens to reduce onsite burden; recruiting to trial 2-day screening cadence (owner: Priya + Recruiting team; pilot start: 2025-09-02).

3) Longer-term health items
   - Formalize "interview load" in quarterly capacity planning so teams can request temporary backfill or reduce sprint commitments when hiring peaks. (Proposal to present to Eng leadership: Priya; draft by 2025-09-15).

Decisions made during the meeting
- We will add a one-line "what to expect" to the candidate invite and the interviewer packet (Aisha owns the content).
- Jonah will enable auto-calendar invites for buddy sessions on offer acceptance (engineering-admin + recruiting coordination).
- Ramp plan for new hires will incorporate an explicit demo-run in week 1; Ethan will record and publish the walkthrough.

Action items (owner / due date)
- Aisha: Draft "what to expect" sentence for candidate invite + interviewer packet. Due 2025-08-24.
- Tomás: Schedule 30m calibration session for interviewers. Due 2025-08-28.
- Maya: Add verified Docker credential steps to onboarding checklist and Confluence. Due 2025-08-26.
- Jonah: Implement auto-create calendar invite for buddy sessions (coord with ops). Due 2025-08-29.
- Ethan: Record 20m new-hire demo walkthrough and drop it in Confluence + onboarding Slack channel. Due 2025-08-30.
- Priya + Recruiting: Draft plan for screening cadence trial and present pilot to recruiting. Pilot start 2025-09-02.
- Priya: Draft proposal to incorporate interview load into quarterly capacity planning. Draft due 2025-09-15.

Open questions / Risks
- Does recruiting have bandwidth to support a 2-day screening cadence pilot starting Sep 2? (Priya to confirm with recruiting lead.)
- Can we get an engineering-admin to own the automation of calendar invites? If not, manual process may be required until SRE time opens up.
- Will recording the walkthrough be accessible for candidates behind the onboarding firewall? Need to confirm access policy for demo artifacts.

Misc notes & references
- Related PR for small onboarding improvements: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/542
- Onboarding Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-612 (please update the "first-run" section only)
- Interview dashboard (hiring metrics): JIRA-PLAT-876 (pipeline + acceptance propensity)
- Slack thread with candidate feedback excerpts: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02PLATFRC/p1728349200000123

Quick retrospective takeaways (1-line each)
- Keep interview expectations explicit in both JD and candidate comms.
- Bake environment setup (credential flow + small demo) into week-0 checklist so new hires can be productive on day 1.
- Avoid piling interviews on the same people who are likely to be on-call the same week.

If anything above needs reprioritization, comment in the Confluence card (CONFLUENCE-ONBOARD-612) and I'll update the owners accordingly.

Notes recorded by: Maya Chen
Next sync: 2025-08-28 (post-calibration session)
